title: Google is Holding Schools Hostage. (This is Not Okay)
summary:
Last week, Google announced that, in response to pressure from parents and educators, it would allow schools to turn off AI tools in their widely used education apps. Cal Newport analyzes this announcement and provides a logical explanation on how to react to this recent news.
